scope: Primary platform documentation and public repository source inspection. Not a claim to have searched every repository or verified live completeness.

bilibili.mode: Independently implemented GET-only web-session adapter; not copied SDK code and not official OAuth API
bilibili.comments: Owner UID + exact BV/aid verification, root and child pagination, exact large integer IDs, pinned root collection, duplicate-page detection
bilibili.messages: Paged session list and latest-message preview only; excludes chat history, acknowledgement, conversation opening and sending
bilibili.followers: Current authenticated user's paged accessible fan list, separate from fan count or demographic statistics
bilibili.tested: RC100 installed and exercised through normal public UI on two owned Bilibili accounts: 24 session summaries (4 + 20), 784 follower records (8 + 776), accessible pagination ended. Comments remain fixture-tested only. No conversations opened or read-acknowledgement requests implemented; real platform unread before/after invariance not independently verified.
bilibili.limits: 10 pages per UI batch with continuation, 5000 rows memory cap, 10-minute owner/session/work-bound cursor; deleted/hidden/restricted records excluded

xiaohongshuFollowup.liveResult: After RC100 normal-UI retest, own-ID assertion passed and the original private work was located. Collection now reports that the official card has no usable work ID. No new comment or pin sent.
xiaohongshuFollowup.change: Use observed creator /new/home route, bounded 12-second identity readiness instead of 2.4 seconds, distinguish unread own identity from actual login expiry
xiaohongshuFollowup.limits: Work ID still missing; live follow-up and pin are not confirmed. A later visible view changed to the publishing editor; further navigation/retries stopped to avoid overwriting possible editing.

wechatFollowup.liveResult: User restored original account login; current normal account-manager UI reports healthy. Original task visibility is platform default, not an explicit private setting.
wechatFollowup.constraint: Do not apply latest private-only test permission to the old potentially public work. Exact official work ID remains pending. No repost or comment sent.

sources.finding: Approved video.comment capability provides comment and child-list reads; this documented top-comment operation is enterprise-only. Browser login alone is not this approval.
fans.list requires application permission and account authorization; described recent fan list, not unrestricted lifetime fan history. Direct document fetch was unavailable in this inspection.
Inbound private-message event route. Does not establish access to arbitrary historical personal inboxes. Qualification details still require checking in the intended application console.
Commercial private-message API entry appears in official app center; account eligibility and creator-wide comment/fan access not established here. Commerce APIs are not substitutes.
Public video comment and child-comment cursor pagination; does not solve private inbox access or prove hidden/deleted comments can be fetched.
Public note comments require note identity/context and root/child pagination; count caps mean method names containing all are not a completeness guarantee.
Non-commercial learning license; not incorporated into this application.
GET paged sessions and POST update_ack are separate operations. Read-only adapter excludes all acknowledgement/send/detail-opening routes. This source is GPL licensed; no SDK code copied.
Root comments, paged child replies and distinct page totals; exact large comment IDs must be preserved.
Paged /x/relation/fans list is distinct from aggregate relation statistics.
Archived repository; not selected as a currently maintained application dependency.
Public user-info fan count is not a follower roster. Live comment delivery and message sharing must not be presented as historical video comments or inbox reads.

unverified: General WeChat Channels creator APIs covering all historical comments, private inbox and complete followers were not verified. Do not substitute WeChat Shop customer support or Official Account APIs.
Douyin, Xiaohongshu and Channels full personal-inbox history without appropriate platform grants remains unverified.
Other account-directory providers have not been verified for these data categories; do not mark them supported based only on a login entry.
safety: Own bound accounts only; no credentials printed, exported or requested in chat; no CAPTCHA bypass; no read acknowledgements; no new public posting under the latest private-only test request; no remote source/artifact upload.
